# GivenTake Devs

> A small web studio in Northeast Ohio. Custom websites for small businesses from $499, quoted in writing before work starts and owned outright by the client. An optional $99/mo care plan covers hosting, updates and a plain-English monthly report. The studio also builds internal dashboards, booking and payment systems, business automation and MVPs at fixed prices. GivenTake Devs is a registered trade name of Giventake Goods LLC.

Every page is server-rendered HTML with JSON-LD. Contact: build@giventakedevs.com.

- [Services](https://giventakedevs.com/services): every fixed-price offer with scope, price and timeline

- [Marketing website](https://giventakedevs.com/services/marketing-site)

## For agents

- MCP endpoint: https://giventakedevs.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key). One tool, request_site_check, files a free five-minute recorded site check for a named person who asked for it and agreed to be emailed.
- [Server card](https://giventakedevs.com/.well-known/mcp.json)
